nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable storing the fixed token price; it is the persistent storage written once in the constructor and read by getPrice().
Constructor of ConstOracle that initializes the immutable tokenPrice once at deployment using the caller-supplied _price argument.
External view function that returns the stored tokenPrice; anyone can read the price and it performs no state mutation or value transfer.
Constructor input parameter _price used only to set the tokenPrice state variable at deployment time.

edges.reason: The constructor parameter _price is assigned directly into the tokenPrice state variable, so its value flows into persistent storage.
The constructor writes to tokenPrice; the deployment-time function is the sole writer of this storage slot.
getPrice() reads the tokenPrice state variable and returns it, creating a read dataflow from storage to the view function output.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter _price is a non-core temporary scoped to the constructor; its only purpose is to initialize tokenPrice, so it is summarized into the constructor core function.
